profile_text: With a focus on construction, this 41-employee strong firm has achieved a 5.1% growth since its baseline, driven by its expertise in delivering specialized building services. As a scaler in the construction sector, it leverages its online presence, including its website wenkemann-gmbh.de, to expand its reach and client base. Based in the Düsseldorf area, the company is well-connected with local trade associations, such as @hwkduesseldorf and @abinshandwerk, facilitating its continued growth and success.
